root_cause_label: Naive Single-Byte Value Extraction from SQLite Binary Records
one_sentence_failure_summary: At step 13 the agent committed to interpreting the single ASCII byte immediately following each stored string as the numeric value, ignoring the 7-byte IEEE 754 double payload visible in the same hex context and also misreading 'testword052' as a single key instead of 'testword05' with value byte 0x32=50.
t_err_evidence: Step 13: agent tests 'hypothesis: value = byte after word' and locks in this interpretation. The hex context printed in step 12 for testword08 shows 8 non-trivial bytes '@X\xff\\(\xf5\xc2\x8f' indicating an IEEE 754 double, yet the agent reads only the first byte '@' (=64). Additionally the regex in step 9 captured 'testword052' as one token instead of 'testword05', silently corrupting a key.
t_commit_evidence: Step 13 writes the flawed extraction logic (single-byte value) and immediately prints all 10 incorrect values; subsequent steps only read and validate the already-written recover.json without re-examining the binary structure.
t_surface_evidence: Step 13 output shows 'testword052 -> 15' (key is wrong) and all values are single-byte integers; the result for testword08 would be 64 instead of the correct float value encoded as an 8-byte double, which is an observable sign of the wrong parse.
trigger_explanation: In step 12 the agent printed the full hex context showing 8 bytes of data after testword08 ('@X\xff\\(\xf5\xc2\x8f'), which is characteristic of an IEEE 754 double stored in SQLite column type 7. The agent saw this output but interpreted only the first byte as the value, misreading the multi-byte double as a single-byte integer.
forewarning_evidence: Step 10 produced mostly 0 values (testword00 through testword07 = 0) and spurious large integers (57407, 264207, 263439) that do not match any plausible column data, signaling that the 4-byte integer search was wrong. Step 12 printed context bytes for testword08 showing 8 non-null trailing bytes inconsistent with a single-byte value, yet the agent did not revisit the schema.
